blocks.content:
• Mayor is the head of a Municipal Corporation.
• Municipal Commissioner is the administrative head.
Mayor is the head of a Municipal Corporation.

items: Distinguish clearly between the Mayor (head of the corporation) and the Municipal Commissioner (administrative head).
Questions often ask for the administrative head of a Municipal Corporation, which is the Municipal Commissioner.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Mayor serves as the head of the Municipal Corporation.
The Municipal Commissioner holds the role of the administrative head.
